description: The current streak on a day, in the goal's own rhythm (decision 43): due days (one weekday: "12 Fridays"), weeks or months for period totals and days per period, occasions for yearly schedules. A day counts when its status keeps the streak (make_up.json: met, minimum only or made up); a period when it meets its requirement; an occasion when every due day in it is kept. Non-due days (unscheduled, paused, excused, outside the active period) are skipped. Today, the current period or the current occasion never breaks the streak while in progress, and adds only once met. Each day is judged by the version in force that day.

hijri_corrections.description: The account's Hijri month-start corrections. Absent means none.

unit.description: What `current` counts (README.md, Streak units): days (due days), one weekday ("12 Fridays"), weeks, months (Gregorian or Hijri), or occasions ("3 Ramadans").

weekday.description: The weekday when unit is weekday; null otherwise.
